scope: Local R3 implementation on top of existing M5e and R0-R2 changes. No commit, push, SDK upgrade or schema migration.

validation.coverage: Real PostgreSQL/pgvector and Spring/MyBatis rollback; loopback model/MCP/Feishu; independent JVM crash recovery; packaged deployment image; synthetic inputs.

initial_regression.cause: SDK 2.0.3 ToolResultBlock.text()/of() defaults to unbound RUNNING before ReAct finalizes a completed tool return.
initial_regression.repair: Only completed unbound raw returns without the native error marker become SUCCESS. Bound RUNNING, errors, denial, interruption and suspension remain rejected. Added explicit regression and reran full clean verification.

architecture.schema_validation_decision: Retain SDK raw-input, effective-input adapter, HTTP answer and business-correction validation. Runtime input and presets make them non-equivalent; negative integration tests verify no budget/artifact side effects.
